import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date and time to datetime
coffee_sales['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'] + ' ' + coffee_sales['time'])

# Create a new column for total sales by product
total_sales_by_product = coffee_sales.groupby('product')['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Sort values for better visualization
total_sales_by_product = total_sales_by_product.sort_values(by='total', ascending=False)

# Create the bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(data=total_sales_by_product, x='total', y='product', palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Product', fontsize=14)
plt.title('Total Sales by Coffee Product', fontsize=16)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(axis='x')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
